2609.11060.title: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents
2609.11060.paper_summary: Persistent memory is entering production-oriented agent platforms to help long-horizon agents accumulate experience across sessions. Yet a post-task curator agent restricted to completed trajectories can preserve errors, overgeneralize partial evidence, or retain stale knowledge. We introduce environment-probing curation, a deployment-compatible extension that gives an existing asynchronous curator agent least-privilege, read-only world tools to check, scope, and refresh candidate memories. It requires no model retraining and leaves the task agent, retriever, memory representation, and production write authority unchanged. In a production-like GitHub Copilot (GHCP) harness built on its SDK, we compare stateless execution, full in-context learning, GHCP + Mem, and GHCP + Mem (w/ Env Probing) on CLBench database exploration and 90 adapted APEX management-consulting tasks. On CLBench, probing raises pass rate from 39% to 73% and pass-discounted reward from 8.60 to 22.60 while reducing queries from 8.8 to 4.7 per question and task-agent cost from \$3.38 to \$1.68. Across six APEX worlds, all 18 memory-versus-baseline mean reward comparisons are positive and task-agent tool calls fall by 16--75%; probing gives the best task-agent reward gain per dollar in five worlds. Probing also attains higher mean reward than GHCP + Mem on both Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7 without schema drift. Environment probing therefore turns existing agent-memory curation into an environment-informed, auditable process while preserving a compact task-time interface.
2609.11060.paper_summary_zh: 持久性記憶正在進入以生產為導向的代理平台，以幫助長期代理在會話中積累經驗。<lb/>然而，一個限制於已完成軌跡的後任務策展代理可能會保留錯誤、過度概括部分證據或保留過時的知識。<lb/>我們介紹了環境探測策展，這是一種兼容部署的擴展，為現有的異步策展代理提供最低特權的只讀世界工具，以檢查、範圍和刷新候選記憶。<lb/>它不需要模型重訓練，並且不改變任務代理、檢索器、記憶表示和生產寫入權限。<lb/>在基於其SDK構建的類生產環境的GitHub Copilot (GHCP) 駕馭中，我們比較了無狀態執行、完整上下文學習、GHCP + Mem和GHCP + Mem (帶環境探測) 在CLBench數據庫探索和90個改編的APEX管理諮詢任務上的表現。<lb/>在CLBench上，探測將通過率從39%提高到73%，將通過折扣獎勵從8.60提高到22.60，同時將每個問題的查詢從8.8減少到4.7，任務代理的成本從\$3.38減少到\$1.68。<lb/>在六個APEX世界中，所有18個記憶與基準的平均獎勵比較都是正面的，任務代理的工具調用減少了16%至75%；探測在五個世界中提供了每美元最佳的任務代理獎勵增益。<lb/>探測在Sonnet 4.6和Opus 4.7上也達到了比GHCP + Mem更高的平均獎勵，且沒有模式漂移。<lb/>因此，環境探測將現有的代理記憶策展轉變為一個環境知情的、可審計的過程，同時保留了一個緊湊的任務時間介面。
